name: tech-asset-marketplace
description: Multi-Vendor Tech Asset Marketplace - React + Vite SPA, Express/TypeScript API, PostgreSQL via Prisma, Stripe + SSLCommerz payments.
comment:no-workspaces: server/ and client/ are INDEPENDENT packages, each with its own
package-lock.json, and this root manifest deliberately does NOT declare
WHY: workspaces hoist a single node_modules and a single root lockfile. That
actively hurts the Docker build here, because each Dockerfile copies only its
own package.json + package-lock.json to get a cache layer that survives source
changes. With a hoisted root lockfile, every image would need the whole
monorepo in its build context, and a change to a frontend dependency would
invalidate the backend's npm ci layer.
Independent locks also mean the API image installs zero frontend packages -
smaller image, smaller CVE surface. The scripts below give the one-command
ergonomics of a monorepo without the coupling.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix client ci
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.prisma:migrate: npm --prefix server exec -- prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:deploy: npm --prefix server exec -- prisma migrate deploy
